slug: 2025-09-04 DARE1 subsea cable expansion to boost internet capacity

facts.fact: SubTel Forum states the DARE1 submarine cable, operational since 2021 with 36 Tbps over three fibre pairs, links Djibouti City with Bosaso and Mogadishu in Somalia and Mombasa in Kenya with partners Hormuud Telecom, Somtel International and Telkom Kenya.

note: Extension south of Mombasa is planned, not in service.
